title_en: Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Practicing Justice for the People, Vigorously Strengthening Impartial Justice, and Continuously Enhancing Judicial Credibility
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Several Opinions on Earnestly Practicing Justice for the People, Vigorously Strengthening Judicial Impartiality, and Continuously Enhancing Judicial Credibility

Fa Fa [2013] No. 9

To thoroughly implement the major deployments of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China on accelerating the construction of a socialist country under the rule of law and General Secretary Xi Jinping's important discourses on the rule of law, to actively respond to the new demands and expectations of the people for the work of the people's courts in the new era, to earnestly practice justice for the people, to vigorously strengthen judicial impartiality, to continuously enhance judicial credibility, and to fully play the functional role of the people's courts, the following opinions are hereby proposed.

I. Raise Ideological Awareness and Always Keep Justice for the People and Judicial Impartiality as the Main Line of the People's Courts' Work

1. Deeply understand the significant practical significance of justice for the people and judicial impartiality. People's courts at all levels should earnestly study the report of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and General Secretary Xi Jinping's important discourses on the rule of law, fully comprehend the profound meaning of "striving to make the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case," and comprehensively recognize the significant practical significance of practicing justice for the people, strengthening judicial impartiality, and enhancing judicial credibility for establishing a good image of the people's courts, maintaining judicial authority, ensuring the effective implementation of the Constitution and laws, advancing the rule of law, and building a China under the rule of law.

2. Firmly grasp the favorable conditions and historical opportunities for the development of the people's courts. The Party Central Committee attaches great importance to the rule of law and places high importance on judicial work, supporting judicial organs in exercising adjudicative power independently and impartially according to law, providing strong political guarantees for the work of the people's courts; the people's ardent expectations for progress in the rule of law and impartial justice provide inexhaustible impetus for the work of the people's courts; the rich experience accumulated by generations of court staff in the long-term process of building a socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics has laid a solid foundation for the scientific development of the people's courts. Courts at all levels should cherish and fully utilize these favorable conditions, firmly grasp this historical opportunity, and through the outstanding practice of impartial, efficient, people-oriented, and incorruptible justice, comprehensively create a new situation in the work of the people's courts and write a new chapter in the development of the people's courts.

3. Effectively solve the prominent problems facing the work of the courts. Currently, the situation facing the work of the people's courts is very complex, the tasks are very arduous, and the people's demands for judicial work are increasingly high. All judges and other court staff should enhance their sense of responsibility and awareness of potential dangers, face up to the gap between the work of the people's courts and the requirements of the Party Central Committee and the expectations of the people, carefully investigate and effectively solve the prominent problems strongly reflected by the people, look inward for reasons, summarize lessons learned, improve work, and strive to raise the level of justice for the people, judicial impartiality, and judicial credibility to a new level.

II. Adhere to Independent Adjudication According to Law, Faithfully Fulfill the Duties Conferred by the Constitution and Laws

4. Strictly handle cases according to law. All judges should further strengthen their belief in advocating the rule of law, being loyal to the law, and strictly enforcing the law, continuously improve their ability to skillfully master the law, accurately understand the law, and correctly apply the law, always adhere to the principle of "taking facts as the basis and the law as the criterion," and must not break through the bottom line of the law for any reason, eliminating any phenomenon of exceeding the law, distorting the law, or other illegal and arbitrary adjudications. In handling each case, the basic requirements of clearly ascertained facts, correct application of law, impartial outcome of the case, lawful trial procedures, and standardized legal documents must be implemented to ensure that the judgment can withstand the test of the law and history.

5. Adhere to the independent exercise of adjudicative power according to law. Resolutely implement the constitutional principle that the people's courts independently exercise adjudicative power according to law, resolutely resist various forms of local and departmental protectionism, resolutely eliminate interference from all extra-legal factors such as power, money, personal connections, and relationships, continuously improve the institutional mechanisms that ensure the people's courts independently and impartially exercise adjudicative power according to law, and resolutely safeguard the dignity and authority of the Constitution and laws. All judges should cultivate the professional character of daring to adhere to principles, daring to uphold the truth, daring to handle cases according to law, and daring to assume responsibility. Presidents, vice presidents, members of the adjudication committee, division chiefs, and deputy division chiefs of courts at all levels should firmly support collegial panels and single-judge benches in hearing cases impartially according to law, and higher-level courts should firmly support lower-level courts in independently and impartially exercising adjudicative power according to law.

6. Adhere to the correct implementation of the law. Further strengthen and improve trial supervision and guidance, strive to enhance the pertinence, scientificity, rationality, and effectiveness of judicial policies and judicial interpretations, and give full play to the important role of guiding cases and reference cases. Establish and improve the rule system for the application of law, regulate discretionary power, unify judicial standards, strictly adhere to adjudication criteria, and continue to promote the standardization of sentencing. Standardize the standards for reversing judgments, remanding for retrial, and initiating retrial. Higher-level courts should both respect the discretionary power of lower-level courts and correct erroneous judgments of lower-level courts according to law.

7. Give play to the guiding role of judicial adjudication. On the basis of accurately grasping the spirit of the law and comprehensively understanding social conditions and public opinion, adjudicate cases impartially according to law, fully leverage the important role of judicial adjudication in highlighting the spirit of the rule of law, strengthening the awareness of rules, leading social trends, and maintaining public order, resolutely uphold the seriousness of the law, and reflect correct value orientation. Incorporate litigation-related petitions into the rule-of-law track; while unblocking the channels for lawful petitions, also handle unreasonable persistent petitions and vexatious litigation according to law, and resolutely uphold the res judicata and authority of judicial judgments.

III. Adhere to Serving the Overall Situation, Strive to Achieve the Unity of Legal Effect and Social Effect

8. Based on national conditions, correctly grasp the thinking of innovation and development of the people's courts. In view of the reality of unbalanced economic and social development in China, courts at all levels should not only continuously improve the level of standardization, specialization, and professionalization, but also continuously innovate trial methods and approaches that conform to the laws of adjudication, are simple and easy to implement, and are convenient and beneficial to the people, to meet the requirements of effectively resolving various conflicts and disputes. On the premise of maintaining the unity of the legal system, properly handle the difficulties in applying the law arising from unbalanced development and adjustment of interest patterns, pay attention to the inclusiveness of judicial policies and judicial interpretations for different regions and different situations, and pay attention to the fairness of judicial rules applicable to members of different social strata.

9. Actively serve the overall situation around judicial functions. Adhere to active justice, give play to judicial functions, abide by the essence of judicial work, make good use of judicial means, and strive to serve the overall situation. Correctly handle the relationship between active justice, serving the overall situation, and performing trial functions according to law, continuously enhance the awareness of the overall situation, and consciously place the work of the people's courts within the overall work of the Party and the state. Through the formulation and implementation of judicial policies and judicial interpretations, strive to achieve the organic integration of trial work and overall work; through individual case adjudication, prudently and properly handle various disputes arising from unbalanced economic and social development, lagging social construction, and social management deficiencies, comprehensively consider the various factors involved in the case and the impact of the judgment on all aspects, and prevent improper handling of individual cases from intensifying social conflicts and affecting social stability. Court staff are strictly prohibited from participating in local investment attraction and joint law enforcement, and from intervening in specific administrative management activities such as land acquisition and house demolition in advance.

10. Pay attention to the integration of judicial adjudication work with social life. Accurately grasp the demands and expectations of the people for the work of the courts, attach great importance to the people's concerns and evaluations of the work of the courts, and earnestly respect the common perception and shared feelings of the people regarding judicial fairness. Continuously strengthen investigation and research on social life, carefully understand the main methods and customary rules of various social relations and social interactions, be good at summarizing and applying common sense and experience recognized by the people, and strive to make the judicial process and outcome close to the people's concept of fairness and justice within the scope of the law. Vigorously promote judicial integrity and social integrity, use litigation activities and judicial judgments to strengthen the protection of honest conduct and increase the punishment of dishonest conduct, enhance the efficiency of integrity, increase the cost of dishonesty, and strictly prevent and legally sanction parties from using litigation to evade responsibility or seek improper benefits.

IV. Focus on Case Handling, Comprehensively Improve the Quality and Efficiency of Trial Work

11. Strengthen trial quality. Deeply understand that achieving high quality, high efficiency, and good results in trial work is a solid foundation for practicing justice for the people, strengthening judicial impartiality, and enhancing judicial credibility. Adhere to taking case handling as the primary task, ensuring trial quality as the primary responsibility, and promoting the parties to cease litigation and settle disputes and voluntarily reach reconciliation as key links, and effectively improve the quality of trials and the production of judgment documents. According to the requirements of improving trial quality, scientifically set up internal institutions, reasonably allocate powers and responsibilities, optimize the allocation of trial resources, and properly equip trial forces, effectively allocating high-quality trial resources to the front line of case handling. Establish, improve, and earnestly implement various systems and mechanisms to ensure trial quality, continuously summarize and promptly promote various experiences and practices conducive to improving trial quality.

12. Establish and improve the trial quality control system. According to the particularity of trial work, construct a multi-angle, comprehensive case quality control system with "points, lines, and surfaces." At the "point" level, focus on controlling key positions, key cases, and key judgments; at the "line" level, focus on controlling important processes and key links of trial activities; at the "surface" level, focus on controlling the basic situation and development trends of trial work. Establish and improve systems conducive to ensuring and improving trial quality, such as trial quality and efficiency analysis systems, analysis and judgment systems for cases reversed or remanded for retrial by second instance and retrial cases, standardized handling systems for routine cases, typical case notification systems, trial experience exchange systems, trial observation and evaluation systems, and judgment document evaluation and spot-check systems.

13. Improve the efficiency of trial and enforcement. Strengthen communication, coordination, and cooperation between case filing, trial, and enforcement, forming a joint force between trial departments and enforcement departments; further standardize trial procedures, reasonably set time limits for each trial node, and eliminate bottlenecks and blockages in the trial process; further standardize service methods, strive to shorten the time for effective service; effectively implement the separation of complex and simple cases, and apply supervision procedures, summary procedures, and small claims procedures according to law. Under the premise of ensuring case quality, strive to shorten the litigation cycle so that the legitimate rights and interests of the parties can be realized as soon as possible. At the same time, pay attention to balanced case conclusion, and must not refuse to accept cases or rush to conclude cases neglecting quality for the sake of increasing the case conclusion rate.

14. Improve the trial quality evaluation system. Further improve the trial quality evaluation system, reasonably set various evaluation indicators and their weights, and continuously improve the scientific level of the trial quality evaluation system. Adhere to the correct judicial performance concept, correctly understand and comprehensively apply the case quality evaluation system, resolutely oppose falsification in judicial statistics and trial quality evaluation, avoid one-sided and isolated pursuit of certain individual evaluation indicators, and give full play to the role of the evaluation system in reflecting the true level of trial work, guiding trial activities to operate fairly and efficiently, and enhancing the work enthusiasm of courts and judges.

15. Improve and perfect the mechanism for evaluating erroneous cases and accountability. According to the actual situation of trial work, establish a scientific and fair evaluation system for erroneous cases, clarify the standards for determining erroneous cases; improve the mechanism for analysis and accountability of erroneous cases, improve the relevant procedures for analysis and accountability of erroneous cases, distinguish different circumstances of erroneous cases and the corresponding responsibilities for different enforcement errors. Through comprehensively establishing and improving the working mechanism for preventing erroneous cases, minimize the occurrence of unjust, false, and wrong cases, and firmly hold the bottom line of preventing unjust, false, and wrong cases at the stage of judicial adjudication.

16. Correctly utilize mediation and judgment methods. Correctly handle the relationship between mediation and judgment, and give full play to the roles and advantages of the two methods. Actively promote and standardize pre-litigation mediation. For disputes where both parties have the willingness to mediate and there is a possibility of mediation, family and neighborhood disputes, disputes where the legal provisions are not sufficiently clear or where simply applying the law may lead to unfair results, priority should be given to mediation while fully respecting the wishes of both parties. In mediation, adhere to the principle of legality and voluntariness. For cases or disputes where the parties are unwilling to mediate or where it is necessary to provide rule guidance for society, judgment methods should be used while respecting the parties' right of disposition.

V. Improve Systems and Mechanisms, Deepen Judicial Transparency and Judicial Democracy

17. Deeply promote the institutionalized construction of trial openness. Adhere to promoting fairness through openness, earnestly summarize successful experiences of trial openness, and further deepen various measures of judicial openness. Starting from the perspective of facilitating social supervision over trial work and enhancing the social credibility of trial work, clearly stipulate the scope, content, objects, time, procedures, and methods of trial openness, steadily and orderly promote judicial openness, unremittingly improve judicial transparency, and gradually improve the institutional mechanisms of judicial openness.

18. Establish and improve platforms for communication between the judiciary and society. Courts at all levels should set up the 12368 telephone hotline to promptly receive and handle public consultations, complaints, and reports, and listen to opinions and suggestions. Accelerate the construction of three major platforms: trial process disclosure platform, judgment document disclosure platform, and enforcement information disclosure platform, and timely disclose trial activity information. Improve the leaders' reception day system and press spokesperson system of the courts to enhance mutual understanding, comprehension, and trust between society and the courts. Actively carry out court theme open day activities, proactively invite and organize representatives from all walks of life to attend trials or visit courts to understand the trial process, the characteristics of trial work, and the working conditions of trial personnel.

19. Give full play to the role of modern information technology. Attach importance to the use of modern information technologies and methods such as the Internet, microblogs (Weibo), and WeChat to expand the influence of judicial openness and enrich the forms and content of judicial democracy. For cases and disputes of widespread social concern, proactively, timely, comprehensively, and objectively disclose relevant information, and respond to the public's concerns and doubts in a targeted manner. Study and grasp the laws and characteristics of the mutual influence between public opinion and judicial trials in the era of self-media, strengthen analysis and judgment of online public opinion, correctly treat opinions and suggestions from all sectors of society, have the courage to correct shortcomings in work, promptly make up for deficiencies in work, and dare to resist unreasonable and illegal demands and malicious media hype, be good at positively guiding public opinion, and gradually form a normalized positive interaction between judicial trials and social public opinion.

20. Consciously accept supervision from all sides. Consciously and actively accept supervision from the People's Congress, democratic supervision from the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), and litigation supervision from the procuratorial organs. Proactively report work to the People's Congress according to law, and actively cooperate with the People's Congress in conducting law enforcement inspections. Do a good job in handling the motions and suggestions of deputies to the People's Congress and the proposals of members of the CPPCC. Implement the work of deputies to the People's Congress and members of the CPPCC inspecting, patrolling, and attending trials. Take procuratorial recommendations seriously and handle protested cases according to law. Extensively listen to opinions and suggestions from all sectors of society regarding the work of the courts, and consciously accept supervision from the people and news media over the work of the courts.

21. Give full play to the role of people's assessors. Optimize the selection and withdrawal mechanisms for people's assessors, improve the selection conditions for people's assessors, expand the selection scope of people's assessors, increase the proportion of grassroots people, and add expert assessors as needed for trial work. Gradually expand the scale of people's assessors according to the requirements of trial work, and implement a "doubling plan" to double the number of people's assessors within two years. Expand the scope of cases in which people's assessors participate in trials according to law, clarify the rights and obligations of people's assessors, strengthen the training of people's assessors, improve their capabilities and levels, strengthen their sense of responsibility, and ensure that people's assessors fully exercise their rights to participate in trials.

22. Effectively guarantee the parties' exercise of litigation rights. Implement the requirements of the principle of respecting and protecting human rights, effectively guarantee the parties' rights to freely express claims according to law, fully state reasons, timely understand the progress of the trial, and criticize and accuse acts infringing on litigation rights. Respect the parties' right to choose procedures, and for procedural matters that can be decided by the parties autonomously or through consultation according to law, allow the parties to decide autonomously or through consultation as much as possible. Strengthen the interpretation of the application of law, the clarification of procedural issues, and the reasoning of adjudicative activities. The judgment document should seriously consider and comprehensively respond to the claims and opinions raised by the parties, specifically explaining the reasons and basis for adopting or not adopting them. During the litigation process, respond promptly and explain the reasons for applications or challenges raised by the parties.

23. Attach great importance to the role of lawyers. Understand and respect the professional stance and concerns of lawyers, effectively guarantee that lawyers perform their duties according to law during the trial, and ensure that lawyers exercise their litigation rights such as reviewing files, presenting evidence, cross-examining evidence, and defending according to law, and seriously consider and comprehensively respond to lawyers' claims and opinions on case handling. Further regulate the relationship between judges and lawyers, with each performing their respective duties, respecting each other, and supervising each other in litigation activities. Improve the mechanism for lawyers to complain about judges' illegal conduct and the feedback mechanism. Handle lawyers' improper conduct such as violating court discipline, making malicious complaints, and defaming the reputation of judges and courts according to law.

24. Deeply carry out exchanges and interactions with the theoretical legal community. Establish a mechanism for regular exchange and interaction of information, business, and personnel between the people's courts and teaching and research institutions. Encourage judges and experts and scholars to jointly undertake legal theory or judicial research topics, and jointly study judicial theory and practice issues. In the process of summarizing trial experience, formulating judicial interpretations, and judicial policies, pay attention to listening to and seriously considering the opinions and suggestions put forward by experts and scholars, promptly incorporate the results of legal theoretical research, and promote mutual promotion and improvement of legal theoretical research and the judicial trial work of the people's courts.

VI. Innovate and Implement Measures for Convenience and Benefits to the People, Enhance the Actual Effect of Justice for the People

25. Strengthen the construction of litigation service windows. Build, manage, and utilize well the litigation service centers, case filing halls, and litigation-related petition reception windows, improve the actual functions of various windows, and strictly implement unified work procedures, judicial etiquette, and service standards. Effectively improve work style, be good at communicating with the people in language and methods they can understand and accept, resolutely overcome the phenomenon of being cold, hard, and pushy towards litigation participants, resolutely eliminate undesirable work styles such as "difficult to enter the door, ugly face, unpleasant words, difficult to get things done," and resolutely eliminate any phenomenon of making things difficult for litigation participants or failing to act when required, striving to provide enthusiastic, lawful, and efficient services for the people to participate in various litigation activities.

26. Improve the effectiveness of measures for convenience and benefits to the people. According to the needs of the people and the actual needs of trial work, carry out convenient and beneficial measures such as appointment handling of cases on holidays, circuit trials, online case filing, and online case handling in light of local conditions. Further refine and improve convenience and benefit measures in the stages of case filing, trial, enforcement, and petitions, and improve the effectiveness of these measures. Pay attention to the special advantages of people's tribunals in being close to the grassroots and understanding public sentiment, strengthen the role of people's tribunals in resolving grassroots civil disputes, and endow people's tribunals with the function of serving as court litigation service points to facilitate grassroots people in filing and responding to lawsuits and participating in other litigation activities.

27. Strengthen guidance and assistance to litigants in litigation. Proceeding from the reality that there are significant differences in the ability and conditions of litigants to participate in litigation at the current stage, while ensuring procedural fairness and equal treatment, attention shall be paid to providing necessary procedural guidance and assistance to litigants, especially those who have not retained defense counsel or agents ad litem, in participating in litigation. Strengthen the notification of litigation rights and obligations, the burden of proof, litigation risks, and other matters. If a litigant applies for the collection of evidence and the application meets the legal requirements, or if the court deems it necessary to investigate or verify evidence, the court shall collect and verify the evidence ex officio. It is necessary to ensure that the specialization and standardization of litigation procedures and litigation activities are continuously improved and always adapted to the continuous improvement of the people's litigation capabilities. Ensure that litigants with right on their side but no money can afford litigation, that litigants with reason and evidence can win their cases, and that litigants who have won their cases can realize their rights and interests in a timely manner.

28. Reduce the litigation costs of litigants. On the premise of ensuring trial quality, lawfully select and apply more economical litigation procedures and procedural measures, actively guide litigants to rationally choose litigation procedures with low costs and negative effects, avoid as much as possible the undue negative impact of the litigation process on the normal production and life of litigants, and prohibit the abuse of coercive measures that harm the legitimate rights and interests of litigants. Promote the inclusion of judicial assistance in the social assistance system, broaden channels for raising judicial assistance funds, improve the system for deferring, reducing, and exempting litigation costs, and continuously expand the scope of judicial assistance beneficiaries.

VII. Deepen the Reform of the Judicial Work Mechanism and Establish a Scientific and Reasonable Trial Operation Mechanism

29. Correctly grasp the overall requirements of judicial reform. Seize the favorable opportunity of the central government's promotion of a new round of judicial reform, and strive to effectively resolve deep-seated problems affecting judicial fairness and constraining judicial capacity by deepening the reform of the judicial system and mechanism. Pay attention to the overall design and comprehensive consideration of the reform, balance short-term and long-term goals, coordinate internal and external reforms, and strengthen coordination and cooperation among reform measures. The design and implementation of reform plans shall respect judicial rules, be adapted to local conditions, and proceed step by step. For major reform measures of great importance, full argumentation must be conducted, pilot projects must be carried out first, and experience must be summarized before comprehensive promotion. Adhere to orderly promotion of reform from top to bottom. While not violating the law and the overall requirements of judicial reform, encourage local courts to explore specific reform measures first and accumulate reform experience, but major reforms affecting the overall situation must be steadily promoted under the unified deployment of the central government.

30. Gradually improve the functional positioning of the four-level courts. In accordance with the provisions of the Constitution, the Organic Law of the People's Courts, and other laws, and in line with the actual needs of resolving case disputes, follow judicial rules to further clarify the functional division and work focus of people's courts at all levels. While focusing on specialized and categorized division of case trials, gradually improve the judicial functional positioning of people's courts at all levels.

31. Deepen the reform of the case jurisdiction system. On the basis of lawfully protecting litigants' litigation rights and facilitating the people's litigation, gradually change the practice of determining the level jurisdiction of cases mainly based on the amount in controversy and the territorial jurisdiction of cases mainly based on administrative divisions. Further improve the systems of designated jurisdiction, elevation of jurisdiction, and centralized jurisdiction, so that cases where independent trial according to law may be subject to illegal interference, cases with difficult legal application, and new types of cases can be tried by other courts or higher-level courts, eliminate litigants' doubts about possible unfair trial due to case jurisdiction, and provide guidance for lower courts to adjudicate similar cases and unify adjudication standards.

32. Deepen the reform of the internal operation mechanism of judicial power. Further implement the collegial panel system, deepen the reform of the collegial panel, improve the deliberation methods of the collegial panel and the powers and responsibilities of its members, and effectively solve problems such as collective deliberation without real debate and simple concurrence. Establish and improve the performance appraisal system of collegial panels. While giving full play to the overall function of the collegial panel, explore and promote the responsibility system of the presiding judge to improve the trial performance of the collegial panel. Deepen the reform of the adjudication committee system, and give full play to the unique role of the adjudication committee in unifying legal application and supervising and guiding trial work. Improve the composition of the adjudication committee, clarify the duties of full-time members of the adjudication committee, improve and perfect the working rules and deliberation procedures of the adjudication committee, implement the principle of democratic centralism in deliberation, and establish a supervision mechanism for the implementation of adjudication committee resolutions. Deepen the reform of the trial management responsibilities of the court president and division chiefs. The trial management responsibilities of the court president and division chiefs shall be concentrated on the review and approval of relevant procedural matters, macro-guidance of comprehensive trial work, comprehensive supervision and management of trial quality and efficiency, and exclusion of the interference of adverse factors on trial activities. Establish a system for recording the entire process of court presidents and division chiefs exercising trial management power, strengthen the constraints and supervision on court presidents and division chiefs exercising trial management power, and prevent the abuse of trial management power.

33. Deepen the reform of the enforcement system and mechanism. Establish an enforcement model with unified management, unified coordination, and separation of powers with checks and balances, and improve the enforcement linkage mechanism. Innovate enforcement work methods, improve the property investigation system for judgment debtors, strengthen the implementation of the property declaration system for judgment debtors, make full and good use of enforcement measures, and effectively use various means to sanction acts of resisting enforcement or evading enforcement. Accelerate the construction of enforcement informatization, promote the sharing of enforcement case information, implement a system for publishing the list of dishonesty judgment debtors, and connect this list with the social credit system. Strengthen the standardization of enforcement, further standardize enforcement procedures and enforcement actions, and promote the specialization of handling enforcement objections, reconsiderations, and enforcement-related trial work. Further improve the enforcement evaluation mechanism, and increase the accountability for passive enforcement and illegal enforcement.

34. Deepen the reform of people's tribunals. Reasonably adjust the regional layout of people's tribunals, strengthen the basic functions of people's tribunals, strengthen the staffing of people's tribunals, and appropriately expand the scope of case jurisdiction of people's tribunals. On the basis of comprehensively considering case circumstances, population size, regional characteristics, and other relevant factors, in line with the idea of resolving disputes locally and shifting the focus of work downward, comprehensively consider and rationally deploy people's tribunals.

VIII. Adhere to the Policy of Strictly Governing the Courts, and Strive to Build an Excellent Court Team

35. Effectively strengthen ideological and political construction. Continue to deepen the education of socialist rule of law concepts and core judicial values for judges and other court staff, continuously strengthen education on judicial conscience and judicial professional ethics, and strive to shape judicial qualities of uprightness, impartiality, and enforcement of the law as firm as a mountain. Vigorously promote the spirit of the rule of law, socialist rule of law culture with Chinese characteristics, and court culture, further strengthen the ideals and beliefs of judges and other court staff, and continuously enhance judges' and other court staff's confidence in the path, theory, and system of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

36. Solidly promote the construction of capacity for fair adjudication. Attach great importance to the cultivation of comprehensive judicial capacity for judges and other court staff, continuously strengthen education and training in legal theory and legal knowledge, and expand knowledge education in other relevant fields. Courts at all levels must comprehensively improve their ability to work with the masses under the new situation, their ability to safeguard social fairness and justice, their ability to communicate in the new media era, and their ability to apply information technology. All judges must focus on improving their ability to preside over trials, ascertain facts, apply law, and resolve conflicts. Improve the judge training system, improve judge training institutions, and guarantee judge training funds. Strictly ensure the training time for预备 judges, establish and improve the pre-job training system and qualification requirements for professional trial positions, and appropriately extend the full-time training time for judge appointments and promotions. Improve training methods, enrich training content, and make full use of online training, on-the-job training, continuing education, joint training, exchange and temporary posting, regular rotation training, and thematic training to actively broaden the platform for judge development. Strengthen the training of young judges, and continuously expand the team of expert judges.

37. Comprehensively strengthen judicial integrity construction. Earnestly implement the responsibility system for party conduct and clean government construction, and deeply advance the construction of the punishment and prevention system for corruption in the people's courts. Strengthen judicial integrity education and clean culture construction, educate all judges and other court staff to maintain noble character and clean conduct, and uphold the professional ethics bottom line of fair adjudication. Aiming at system defects and management loopholes prone to breeding corruption, reform and innovate systems and mechanisms, further improve the clean government system to resist the temptation of money, interference from personal relationships, and avoid conflicts of interest, and take more forceful measures to ensure the rigid operation of the clean government system. Centering on the operation of judicial power, continue to build a clean government risk prevention and control mechanism that conforms to judicial rules, strengthen internal supervision measures such as judicial inspections, judicial affairs supervision, and the establishment of clean government supervisors in trial and enforcement departments, and effectively strengthen the restriction and supervision of the operation of judicial power to ensure fair and clean adjudication. Continue to strictly enforce the implementation of disciplinary regulations such as the "Five Prohibitions", and resolutely investigate and punish corruption, dereliction of duty, abuse of power, and other corrupt and illegal acts.

38. Further strengthen the construction of judicial work style. Always take "everything for the masses, relying on the masses, coming from the masses, and going to the masses" as the starting point and foothold of the work of the people's courts, and find the combination point of the work of the people's courts and adhering to the mass line. Always stand firm on the mass stance, adhere to the mass viewpoint, enhance feelings for the masses, maintain close ties with the masses, strive to win the trust of the masses, and internalize the concept of justice for the people in the heart and externalize it in action. Carry forward the work style of integrating theory with practice, proceeding from reality in everything, and seeking truth and pragmatism, encourage and cultivate the professional spirit among judges and other court staff of enduring hardship, fearing no difficulties, being indifferent to fame and fortune, daring to take responsibility, and being willing to dedicate, and win social respect with good conduct and personality charm.

39. Steadily promote the construction of a classified management system for the court team. Effectively follow the laws of trial work and the laws of cadre management, and in accordance with the standards of "regularization, professionalization, and specialization", gradually establish a system with scientific classification, reasonable structure, clear responsibilities, and standardized management. In accordance with the overall requirements of the central judicial reform, adhere to proceeding from China's national conditions and the actual situation of trial work, further clarify the responsibilities and rights of judges, trial support personnel, and judicial administrative personnel, and scientifically set the proportion of ranks and the number of positions for various types of personnel based on factors such as work requirements and job responsibilities. Further improve the separate job sequence system for judges and supporting measures, promote the job sequence management of court clerks and judicial police, and improve management measures for trial support personnel and judicial administrative personnel.

40. Gradually advance the reform of the judge selection system. By promoting the improvement of relevant legislation, further strict the conditions for judge appointment. Improve and implement the system of selecting judges level by level, and gradually implement the selection of judges of higher courts from judges of lower courts. Further expand the scope of judge selection, focus on selecting judges from the group of lawyers and other legal practice departments with grassroots work experience, and attract outstanding legal talents from society to join the judge team. Optimize the procedures and methods for judge selection, and effectively ensure the accurate selection of qualified judge talents.

41. Improve the judge performance evaluation mechanism. Establish a scientific and reasonable trial performance evaluation mechanism supported by information technology and conforming to the laws of trial work, and fully reflect the role of evaluation results in promotions, rank advancement, and selection of outstanding personnel. Establish and improve a normalized commendation and reward mechanism to effectively stimulate judges' sense of honor and responsibility based on their positions. Through activities such as striving for excellence and selecting business pacesetters, cultivate and promote expert judges proficient in business, and give full play to the exemplary and leading role of expert judges. Promote the establishment of a judge withdrawal mechanism, and timely transfer judges unsuitable for trial work away from trial positions and remove their judge titles.

IX. Further Strengthen Judicial Guarantees to Provide Strong Support for Justice for the People and Fair Adjudication

42. Establish and improve the judge professional guarantee mechanism. Implement the Judges Law, strengthen the professional guarantee for judges, establish and improve the mechanism for guaranteeing judges' status, the mechanism for guaranteeing their performance of duties according to law, and the mechanism for personal safety protection, and effectively guarantee judges' performance of judicial duties according to law. Gradually improve the working and living conditions of judges, and continuously enhance the sense of responsibility and honor of the judge profession.

43. Continue to strengthen judicial funding guarantees. Consolidate and deepen the achievements of the reform of the court funding guarantee system, establish and improve a mechanism for the orderly growth of court case handling and office operation funds, and promote the central finance to increase the transfer payment to intermediate and basic courts in central and western regions for case handling funds.

44. Accelerate the construction of court informatization. In accordance with the requirements of strengthening the court through science and technology, take the "Balance Project" construction as the carrier, promote the integrated construction, full coverage, and coordinated application of the information technology infrastructure of the four-level courts nationwide. Build an effective connection and unified management nationwide court case information management system, case information inquiry system, judgment document online publishing system, and the official website of the people's court and other information carriers or platforms. Insist on the close integration of basic construction, upgrading and improvement, and in-depth application, and play the role of information networks in judicial statistics, online case handling, online office work, judicial openness, trial supervision, trial management, judge training, court publicity, judicial research, and theoretical research.

45. Further consolidate the grassroots foundation. Always adhere to the policy of facing the grassroots, serving the grassroots, and building the grassroots, continue to strengthen the standardization, informatization, and infrastructure construction of basic courts and people's tribunals, and strive to improve the case handling conditions of basic courts and people's tribunals. Insist on implementing special subsidies for basic courts and people's tribunals in place, and actively coordinate to solve problems such as debts in grassroots infrastructure construction. Increase efforts in the selection, supplementation, and training of judges in basic courts. Actively improve the working and living environment of grassroots judges, promote relevant departments to increase the rank ratio and living treatment of grassroots judges, effectively solve practical problems such as the loss of talent and judge shortage at the grassroots level, and strive to create a system and mechanism where outstanding talents are willing to stay and work peacefully at the grassroots level. Increase guidance to the work of basic courts, establish and improve a system for judges from higher courts to exchange and hold positions at the grassroots level, help basic courts and people's tribunals continuously improve their judicial capacity and level, and promote the coordinated and balanced development of grassroots work in courts nationwide.

Earnestly practicing justice for the people, vigorously strengthening fair adjudication, and continuously improving judicial credibility is not only the glorious historical responsibility of the people's courts but also a very complex systematic project. People's courts at all levels must always adhere to the leadership of the Party, consciously accept the supervision of the People's Congresses and their standing committees at all levels, the democratic supervision of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, rely on government support and the cooperation of other law enforcement agencies, and continuously win the trust, understanding, and support of the people. The enthusiasm and creativity of all judges and other court staff must be fully mobilized and brought into play, the focus of work and attention must be concentrated on the various tasks of judicial case handling, each case must be carefully tried, and every task must be solidly completed. It is necessary to effectively solve the prominent problems currently existing, let all sectors of society feel the new style and new achievements of the work of the people's courts, and more importantly, focus on the construction of systems and mechanisms to fundamentally guarantee the long-term effect of justice for the people and fair adjudication, and ensure the sustained and stable improvement of judicial credibility.
